messages:
Priya Rao: Hey partners team — finalizing run-of-show for the joint webinar with EdgeHub + Nimbus next Wed (Oct 11). Can folks confirm speaker order and demo ownership? :calendar:
Sam Kim: I'm good to present Redwood intro + SLOs. Do we want Alex to cover deployment flow?
Marta Lopez: EdgeHub will demo hardware acceleration, Evan will run the SI integration flow. We need Nikhil for the quantized model note.
Alex W: Can do deployment flow. Need slides by EOD Monday. I'll take ops slide.
Nikhil Gupta: I'll prepare 2 slides on quantization and expected latency delta. Need access to sample prompts — can someone drop in the shared deck?
Priya Rao: Shared deck link: https://redwood.share/s/partner-webinar-deck (edit access for presenters).
Jules (EdgeHub): Confirming hardware loaners: 2 dev kits + 1 laptop arriving Tuesday AM. Logistics will label 'EdgeHub / Redwood'.
Logistics (3PL): Shipping manifest updated. ETA Tue 9am. Will hold at venue check-in. Need onsite contact.
Sam Kim: Onsite contact = Marta. Marta, phone?
Marta Lopez: +1-415-555-0123. I'll be there at 8am.
Evan (Nimbus): For demo fallback, if hardware is flaky we switch to cloud-hosted video capture. Need recorded demo clip (90s).
Alex W: I'll record a fallback clip and upload to drive.
Priya Rao: Quick check on joint announcement embargo — marketing wants to announce same day as webinar at 12pm PT. Partners ok?
Jules (EdgeHub): All good.
Evan (Nimbus): OK.
Priya Rao: SWAG — two options: co-branded stickers + small power bank. Budget approved for 200 units. Logistics: confirm printing deadline Fri COB.
Logistics (3PL): Power bank vendor needs final art by Thu noon. Stickers by Fri.
Sam Kim: Who owns art? I can produce final art tomorrow.
Marta Lopez: Partner logos: EdgeHub SVG and Nimbus PNG (72dpi ok). Priya, can you drop?
Priya Rao: Dropped in deck folder.
deploy-bot: Deployed rehearsal environment at https://rehearsal.redwood/345 — join as guest.
Alex W: Rehearsal scheduled Tue 10am PT. Please test remote audio.
Priya Rao: Action items recap:
- Sam: final slides by Mon EOD
- Alex: fallback clip uploaded by Tue morning
- Nikhil: quant slides by Mon EOD
- Logistics: swag proofs to team by Thu noon
- Marketing: embargo + press sync confirmed for 12pm PT on day-of
I'll update the shared doc with owners + deadlines.
Sam Kim: ack :thumbsup:
